title: Junior Steel Detailer
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a Steel Detailer?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
apply_instructions: Apply on SEEK (advert 95144059); no link out and no applications email in the advert.
rationale: Junior detailing role that asks for some CAD or drafting experience and says attitude and willingness to learn matter more than prior detailing work.

Duties (reading architectural and engineering drawings, drawing revisions, take offs, keeping drawings organised) match Marc's AutoCAD drafting from his Advanced Diploma and his drawing reviews on site.
Direct employer, full time, $70k to $80k; Western Sydney means relocation from Melton.
caution: Steel detailing for residential and modular buildings is adjacent to, not inside, his civil road and drainage target. Steel detailing software is not on record. Sydney relocation needed.
gaps: No steel detailing or detailing software experience
